publications.title: S³-LoRA: Sharpness-Score Sampling for Efficient and Generalizable Low-Rank Adaptation
figure_alt: Overview of the S³-LoRA sharpness-score sampling framework
S³-LoRA 锐度评分采样框架总览
abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a cornerstone of parameter-efficient fine-tuning for large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). While incorporating Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) principles theoretically enhances generalization by prioritizing perturbation-sensitive samples, existing approaches face two critical limitations: prohibitive computational overhead that negates LoRA’s efficiency, and a failure to exploit sample heterogeneity by treating all instances uniformly. To address these issues, we propose a Sharpness-Score Sampling framework for LoRA (S³-LoRA). Specifically, to enable efficient per-sample sharpness estimation, we design a lightweight sharpness proxy using only a single perturbed forward pass, guided by Exponential Moving Average (EMA) perturbations. Furthermore, we introduce a drift-corrected scoring mechanism that dynamically distinguishes intrinsic perturbation sensitivity from global optimization drift and persistent sample difficulty, which enables practical online example selection without incurring the full cost of SAM-style estimation. We provide theoretical analysis for the perturbation mechanism and the effectiveness of prioritizing high-sensitivity examples. Extensive experiments on reasoning, language understanding, code generation, and vision-language benchmarks demonstrate that S³-LoRA consistently achieves superior or comparable performance with more than a 1.3× training speedup, establishing new state-of-the-art benchmarks for this field.

低秩适配（LoRA）已成为大语言模型（LLM）与视觉语言模型（VLM）参数高效微调的基础方法。锐度感知最小化（SAM）通过优先考虑对扰动敏感的样本，在理论上有助于改善泛化，但现有方法存在两项关键局限：高昂的计算开销抵消了 LoRA 的效率优势，以及统一处理所有样本、未能利用样本异质性。为此，我们提出 LoRA 的锐度评分采样框架 S³-LoRA。该框架利用指数移动平均（EMA）引导的扰动，仅通过一次扰动前向计算构建轻量锐度代理，实现高效的逐样本锐度估计。进一步引入漂移校正评分机制，动态区分样本固有的扰动敏感度、全局优化漂移与持续的样本难度，从而在不承担完整 SAM 估计开销的情况下实现实用的在线样本选择。我们从理论上分析了扰动机制，以及优先选择高敏感度样本的有效性。在推理、语言理解、代码生成与视觉语言基准上的大量实验表明，S³-LoRA 在持续取得更优或相当性能的同时，实现超过 1.3 倍的训练加速。

publications.title: FAVR: Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Policies
figure_alt: Overview of the FAVR flow-aware visual residual alignment framework
FAVR 流感知视觉残差对齐框架总览
abstract: Pretrained video representations provide rich temporal information for robotic manipulation, yet effectively integrating them into existing vision-language-action (VLA) policies remains challenging. We present Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment (FAVR), a lightweight framework for flow-aware visual conditioning of frozen VLA policies. FAVR maintains a compact temporal visual state through linear Test-Time Training (TTT) and retrieves action-conditioned visual features throughout flow-based action generation. By exploiting the affine structure of the frozen action head, we explicitly characterize how injected visual features influence predicted action velocities and formulate flow-aware channel selection as a box-constrained optimization problem. We develop a FISTA-based solver for joint gate optimization and derive an efficient closed-form approximation through diagonalization and rescaling. With only 1.74–2.19M trainable parameters and 5,000 adaptation steps, FAVR improves pretrained VLA policies across benchmarks. On RoboTwin 2.0, FAVR improves LingBot-VLA from 87.12% to 90.04% under clean conditions and from 86.88% to 89.38% under randomized conditions. A controlled ablation on five RoboTwin tasks further shows that flow-aware gating increases average success from 72.0% with a gate shared across flow steps to 82.0%, demonstrating the benefit of adapting visual conditioning throughout action generation.

预训练视频表征为机器人操作提供了丰富的时序信息，但如何将其有效融入现有视觉语言动作（VLA）策略仍具挑战。我们提出流感知视觉残差对齐（FAVR），一种为冻结 VLA 策略提供流感知视觉条件的轻量框架。FAVR 通过线性测试时训练（TTT）维护紧凑的时序视觉状态，并在基于流的动作生成过程中持续检索以动作为条件的视觉特征。利用冻结动作头的仿射结构，我们显式刻画注入视觉特征对预测动作速度的影响，将流感知通道选择表述为带盒约束的优化问题。我们设计了基于 FISTA 的联合门控优化求解器，并通过对角化与缩放推导出高效的闭式近似。仅需 174 万至 219 万可训练参数和 5,000 步适配训练，FAVR 即可在多个基准上提升预训练 VLA 策略。在 RoboTwin 2.0 上，FAVR 将 LingBot-VLA 在干净条件下的成功率由 87.12% 提升至 90.04%，在随机化条件下由 86.88% 提升至 89.38%。五项 RoboTwin 任务的受控消融实验进一步表明，与跨流步骤共享门控相比，流感知门控将平均成功率从 72.0% 提升至 82.0%，验证了在动作生成全程动态调整视觉条件的价值。
